dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a measure μ and real-valued X, this is the ENNReal infimum of all scales t satisfying LocalDef010: X is measurable, t is nonzero and finite, exp(X²/(t.toReal)²) is μ-integrable, and its integral is at most 2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the central extended-nonnegative scale N(μ,X) whose finiteness is assumed, whose consequences are asserted, and whose upper bounds by ofReal(CK) are concluded.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: A conjunction asserting four consequences at N=LocalDef001 μ X: a Gaussian tail bound μ{|X|≥t}≤2 exp(-t²/(2N.toReal)²) for t≥0; moment growth with constant 16e N.toReal; integrability and integral-at-most-2 of exp(X²/N.toReal²); and, when X is integrable and centered, an all-λ linear MGF bound exp((128e)² λ² N.toReal²), with integrability of every exponential.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target requires this entire consequence bundle for every measurable X with finite N, independently of the later minimality bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: A tag-indexed predicate on a scale K. It dispatches the five constructors of LocalDef004 respectively to LocalDef020 (tail), LocalDef015 (moment), LocalDef019 (square-window), LocalDef018 (square-point), and LocalDef014 (linear-MGF).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It packages the alternative hypotheses from which N≤ofReal(CK) is inferred; the target uses the tail, moment, square-point, and, in a separate centered clause, linear-MGF tags.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: A finite inductive index type with five constructors, distinguished by D005, D006, D007, D008, and D017 and eliminated by D023.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes which analytic condition LocalDef003 means; the quantified first minimality clause restricts the index to exactly three constructors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: The fifth constructor of LocalDef004, mapped by the recursor to the linear-MGF condition LocalDef014.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It selects the centered all-λ linear-MGF hypothesis in the final minimality clause.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The second constructor of LocalDef004, mapped to the moment-growth condition LocalDef015.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is one of the three allowed indices in the first minimality clause.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: The fourth constructor of LocalDef004, mapped to the square-exponential-at-one-scale condition LocalDef018.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is one of the three allowed indices in the first minimality clause.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: The first constructor of LocalDef004, mapped to the tail condition LocalDef020.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is one of the three allowed indices in the first minimality clause.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: The moment-growth predicate at K: X is μ-a.e. measurable and for every real p≥1, |X|^p (real power) is integrable and ∫|X|^p dμ≤(K√p)^p.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It occurs inside the D002 consequence at K=16e N.toReal and inside the moment-tag premise LocalDef015.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: Admissibility of an ENNReal scale t: X is measurable, t≠0, t≠∞, exp(X²/(t.toReal)²) is integrable, and its integral is at most 2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The set of such t is infimized in D001; the explicit nonzero and finite restrictions do not automatically transfer to its infimum.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the natural number 1+1=2 is at least two, enabling its numeral cast.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies typeclass evidence for occurrences of the real numeral 2 in D002.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that 15+1=16 is at least two, enabling its numeral cast.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies typeclass evidence for the constant 16 in D002.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that 127+1=128 is at least two, enabling its numeral cast.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies typeclass evidence for the constant 128 in D002.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: The linear-MGF condition at K: X is measurable, K>0, X is integrable and centered, and for every real λ, exp(λX) is integrable with ∫exp(λX)dμ≤exp(K²λ²).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the condition selected by D005; together with redundant outer centering/integrability and positivity assumptions it implies N≤ofReal(CK).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: The moment condition at K: X is measurable, K>0, and LocalDef009 μ X K holds.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the condition selected by D006 in the first minimality clause.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: A nondependent wrapper around the five-case eliminator for LocalDef004, with branch order D008, D006, D017, D007, D005.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the tag dispatch in LocalDef003 and fixes the precise tag-to-condition correspondence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: The third constructor of LocalDef004, mapped to the square-window condition LocalDef019.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies the only one of the five analytic-condition tags for which the target states no minimality implication.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: The square-point condition at K: X is measurable, K>0, exp(X²/K²) is integrable, and ∫exp(X²/K²)dμ≤2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is selected by D007 and yields N≤ofReal(CK) in the first minimality clause.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: The square-window condition at K: X is measurable, K>0, and for every real λ with |λ|≤1/K, exp(λ²X²) is integrable and its integral is at most exp(K²λ²).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is selected by D017, but D017 is excluded from both minimality conclusions; it matters for understanding the completeness and omission of cases.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: The tail condition at K: X is measurable, K>0, and for every real t≥0, μ.real({ω: |X(ω)|≥t})≤2 exp(-t²/K²).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is selected by D008 and yields N≤ofReal(CK) in the first minimality clause.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: Another proof that 1+1=2 is at least two, enabling numeral casting.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the real constant 2 appearing in the local square-exponential/tail definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: An abbreviation applying the five-branch recursor D023 in branch order tail, moment, square-window, square-point, linear-MGF.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It underlies D016 and hence the exact behavior of LocalDef003.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: The primitive recursor for the five-constructor index LocalDef004.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It guarantees that LocalDef003 is exhaustive over exactly five tags and fixes its branch identities.

dependency_coverage.name: And

dependency_coverage.name: PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero

dependency_coverage.name: Real.normedAddCommGroup

dependency_coverage.name: Real.normedCommRing

dependency_coverage.name: CompleteLinearOrder.toConditionallyCompleteLinearOrderBot

binders: There exists a single real constant C, quantified before every probability space, measure, random variable, condition tag, and scale.
Universally quantify a type Ω with a measurable-space structure, a measure μ on Ω with an IsProbabilityMeasure instance, and a real-valued function X:Ω→ℝ.
In the first minimality clause, universally quantify a tag i among the tail, moment, and square-point constructors, and then every implicit real K.
In the final centered clause, universally quantify every implicit real K after assuming X is integrable and has integral zero.
hypotheses: For the main assertion, X is Borel-measurable and N(μ,X)=inf{t∈ENNReal: t≠0, t≠∞, exp(X²/(t.toReal)²) is integrable and has integral at most 2} satisfies N(μ,X)<∞.
For tag-indexed minimality, i is exactly the tail tag, the moment tag, or the square-point tag; K>0; and the corresponding LocalDef003 condition at K holds.

For linear-MGF minimality, X is integrable and centered, K>0, and the linear-MGF tag condition at K holds; that tagged condition itself redundantly includes measurability, K>0, integrability, and centering.
conclusions: The full LocalDef002 consequence bundle holds: the stated Gaussian tail estimate, the real-p moment estimate at 16eN, the exponential-square estimate at N itself, and, for centered integrable X, the all-real-λ linear-MGF estimate at 128eN, including each stated integrability assertion.
For each of the tail, moment, and square-point tagged conditions at any K>0, N(μ,X)≤ENNReal.ofReal(CK).
If X is integrable and centered, then the linear-MGF tagged condition at any K>0 also implies N(μ,X)≤ENNReal.ofReal(CK).
mathematical_definitions: Write N=N(μ,X) for the ENNReal infimum of finite nonzero t such that X is measurable, exp(X²/(t.toReal)²) is μ-integrable, and ∫exp(X²/(t.toReal)²)dμ≤2; the definition does not assert that the infimum is attained.
Tail(K): X is measurable, K>0, and for all real t≥0, μ({|X|≥t}) converted to Real is at most 2exp(-t²/K²).
Moment(K): X is measurable, K>0, X is a.e. measurable, and for every real p≥1, |X|^p is integrable and ∫|X|^p dμ≤(K√p)^p, where powers with exponent p use Real.rpow.
SquareWindow(K): X is measurable, K>0, and for all real λ with |λ|≤1/K, exp(λ²X²) is integrable and ∫exp(λ²X²)dμ≤exp(K²λ²).
SquarePoint(K): X is measurable, K>0, exp(X²/K²) is integrable, and ∫exp(X²/K²)dμ≤2.
LinearMGF(K): X is measurable, K>0, X is integrable with ∫X dμ=0, and for every real λ, exp(λX) is integrable and ∫exp(λX)dμ≤exp(K²λ²).
The five LocalDef004 tags map in order to Tail, Moment, SquareWindow, SquarePoint, and LinearMGF.
translation.proposition_plain_english: There is a universal real constant C≥1 such that on every measurable probability space, every measurable real X whose infimal exponential-square scale N is finite satisfies a specific bundle of subgaussian consequences: for every t≥0, μ{|X|≥t}≤2exp(-t²/(2N.toReal)²); for every real p≥1, |X|^p is integrable and ∫|X|^p≤(16e·N.toReal·√p)^p; exp(X²/N.toReal²) is integrable with integral at most 2; and, if X is integrable and centered, then for every real λ, exp(λX) is integrable with integral at most exp((128e)²λ²N.toReal²). Moreover, for every K>0, each of Tail(K), Moment(K), and SquarePoint(K) implies N≤ENNReal.ofReal(CK); and, under an outer integrability-and-centering assumption, LinearMGF(K) also implies that same bound. No minimality implication is stated for SquareWindow(K).

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: C is one universal real constant shared by all measurable spaces, probability measures, functions X, tags, and K; it is not allowed to depend on any of them.
The domain is arbitrary measurable spaces with an IsProbabilityMeasure instance and real-valued Borel-measurable X; no finiteness, topology, or standard-Borel structure on Ω is assumed.

N is an ENNReal set infimum over nonzero finite admissible scales. It need not itself be admissible or nonzero. N<∞ excludes top but permits N=0, so formulas containing division by N.toReal² rely on Lean's totalized real division (0⁻¹=0).
If the admissible-scale set is empty, the complete-lattice infimum is top, so the premise N<∞ rules out that empty-set case; it still does not provide a minimizing witness.
ENNReal.toReal sends top to 0, but the explicit premise N<∞ prevents that boundary in the target's analytic formulas.
ENNReal.ofReal truncates negative inputs to 0. Here C≥1 and K>0 imply CK>0 mathematically, so this truncation should not weaken the intended upper bounds.
The moment condition is quantified over every real p≥1 and uses Real.rpow, not merely integer moments; this is a substantive domain choice.

The first minimality implication covers exactly Tail, Moment, and SquarePoint. SquareWindow is excluded, while LinearMGF is handled separately with outer integrability and centering assumptions that are also already included in the tagged condition.

Several hypotheses are redundant: outer measurability accompanies tagged conditions that already include measurability; outer K>0 accompanies tagged conditions that include K>0; and the final outer centered-integrable premise repeats fields of LinearMGF(K).

Measure.real converts an ENNReal measure value to Real and would map infinity to 0; probability normalization is intended to make event measures finite, but the exact IsProbabilityMeasure fields are not displayed in the dossier.
The target asserts all integrability conjuncts explicitly; they are part of the conclusion or premise and cannot be erased by reading integrals merely as expectations.
No independence, symmetry, identical distribution, atomicity, dimension, or nondegeneracy assumption on X is encoded.
ambiguities: D037 provides only the type of IsProbabilityMeasure, not its constructors or fields, so the exact normalization axiom imposed on μ cannot be independently recovered from this dossier, although its intended role is clear.

D039 exposes the integral only through an opaque wrapper projection; its role as the real Bochner integral is clear from the declaration and instances, but the dossier does not reveal every totalization convention of the implementation.
